structured.answer: Open a securities account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" every month. With the page's numbers (10,000 ₪ now + 500 ₪ a month, 10 years, 7%) I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪ in today's money, against 70,000 ₪ put in.

stuck.why: פסגות is cheapest but לאומי, a name I trust more, is only ~3,000 ₪ behind; hesitated which to pick
About 20 funds that look almost the same with lots of colored tags; I only chose because of the 'הזול' star
Wanted to put in my 30,000 but left the defaults, so the final number isn't really mine
No clear first step, had to guess I open the account at פסגות and then buy the fund
